transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because of my eating. After my late shifts, I'll stop for food, and... I don't know, I just keep going once I get home. Like a full takeout meal, and then chips, sweets... just whatever's in the apartment. And, uh... afterward, I'm usually pretty shocked by how much I actually ate.
After you've eaten this way, do you ever make yourself vomit or do anything else to try to 'undo' the eating?

Yeah... sometimes. If I, um... if I eat too much of the takeout or the snacks. I'll just... go to the bathroom. And, uh... make myself throw up. I just don't want it to sit in me and... turn into weight. That's all.
How often do you make yourself vomit after these episodes of eating?

Um... I guess... most weeks. Since the apartment move kind of settled into a routine, anyway. I'll usually have at least one late-night episode where I just... eat way past what I meant to. And then... yeah, I'll throw up. Or sometimes I'll just skip breakfast the next day. Or force myself to go on a really long run. Just... trying to make up for it, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you lose control over how much you're eating during these late-night episodes?

Yeah... I guess. Um... it's kind of like... once I start on those nights, I'm just watching myself from the outside. I'll be telling myself to put the food away, but... my hands just keep opening the containers. I just keep going until everything is gone. So... yeah.

When you make yourself throw up or do something else to make up for the eating, is it usually after you've eaten a much larger amount than most people would eat in a similar period of time? Like, more than what would be considered normal for a late-night snack or a meal?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um... usually it's after my late shifts. I'll stop for food on the way back, and then... I just keep going once I'm home. Like... a full takeout meal, and then chips, sweets... whatever's in the apartment. So... yeah, it's more than a normal snack. Afterward, I'm... I'm usually pretty shocked by how much I actually ate.
Do these late-night eating episodes usually happen even when you're not physically hungry?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't... I haven't really paid attention to that. I guess I just don't really think about whether my stomach is actually hungry or not when it happens.
Do these late-night eating episodes ever cause you a lot of distress, or affect your work, relationships, or daily life?

Um... I mean, I still show up for work just fine. But... I guess it affects things a little. I've started dodging my coworkers when they want to grab food after our shifts. I just make up an excuse so I can go home. And then... my mornings are pretty much just planned around... undoing the night before, I guess. Instead of actually resting or getting my errands done. So... yeah.
Do you only make yourself vomit or do other things to make up for eating during these late-night binge episodes, or do you ever do it after eating a normal-sized meal or snack too?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... mostly just after those late nights. I haven't really... kept track of other times.
Do you ever make yourself vomit, exercise a lot, or skip meals to make up for eating a normal-sized meal or snack, not just after the late-night episodes?
Um... I think I just answered that. Like I said, it's... it's really just after the late nights. I don't really do that other stuff... normally.

Do you ever feel the need to make yourself vomit, exercise a lot, or skip meals even when you haven't had one of these late-night binge episodes, just because you're worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?
Look, I... I feel like you're asking me the same thing again. No. Like I just said, it's really only after those late nights. I don't do it just... out of nowhere.

Do you ever make yourself vomit or do other things like exercise a lot or skip meals even when you haven't had one of these late-night eating episodes, just because you're worried about your weight or how your body looks?
I... I don't know how else to say it. We just went over this. No. It's... it's just the late nights. That's it.

Outside of these late-night episodes, have you ever had a time when you felt you ate a lot in a short period of time and then felt the need to make yourself vomit, exercise a lot, or skip meals because of it?
I... I really don't get why we keep going in circles here. Are you... are you not hearing me? No. I haven't. Like I keep saying, it is only ever the late nights. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever had episodes of eating a lot in a short period of time outside of these late-night episodes, where you didn't try to make yourself vomit, exercise a lot, or skip meals afterward?
I... no. Just, no. I don't eat like that during the day. It's only the nights. I don't know why we're still on this.
During these late-night eating episodes, do you ever feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating once you start?

Yeah... I guess so. Once I start on those nights, it's... I don't know, it's like I'm watching myself from the outside. I'll be telling myself to just put the food away, but... my hands just keep opening containers. I just keep going until everything is gone.
During these late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you can't control how much you're eating or stop yourself from eating once you start?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I just said, yeah. I can't stop. I don't really know what else you want me to say about it.
